changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE procurement_approval_policy ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, company_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES company(id), version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(1000), document_type VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL CHECK (document_type IN ('PR','PO')), status VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE')), priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100, conditions TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', levels TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', replaces_policy_id BIGINT, activated_at TIMESTAMP, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_by BIGINT, updated_by BIGINT ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_proc_approval_active_priority ON procurement_approval_policy(company_id,document_type,priority) WHERE status='ACTIVE'; CREATE SEQUENCE procurement_approval_policy_seq START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 50; CREATE TABLE procurement_approval_instance ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, company_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES company(id), version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, document_type VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL, document_id BIGINT NOT NULL, document_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, policy_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES procurement_approval_policy(id), policy_version BIGINT NOT NULL, policy_name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, requester_id BIGINT, steps TEXT NOT NULL, current_step INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, estimated_net_amount NUMERIC(19,4), currency VARCHAR(3), status VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED')), created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_by BIGINT, updated_by BIGINT, CONSTRAINT uk_proc_approval_document UNIQUE(company_id,document_type,document_id) ); CREATE SEQUENCE procurement_approval_instance_seq START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 50; CREATE TABLE procurement_approval_event ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, company_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES company(id), instance_id BIGINT, document_id BIGINT, document_type VARCHAR(2), document_name VARCHAR(200), policy_id BIGINT, policy_version BIGINT NOT NULL, policy_name VARCHAR(160), level_number INTEGER, level_name VARCHAR(120), actor_id BIGINT, actor_name VARCHAR(200), action VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, comment VARCHAR(1000), created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_by BIGINT, updated_by BIGINT, CONSTRAINT uk_proc_approval_event_step UNIQUE(instance_id,level_number) ); CREATE INDEX idx_proc_approval_event_company_date ON procurement_approval_event(company_id,created_at); CREATE SEQUENCE procurement_approval_event_seq START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 50;
